purpose: Non-authoritative integration routing manifest for agentic tooling around MiseOS Dev ID.
authorityBoundary: The manifest never grants authority. Host-side policy, authorization, registry state, and the fail-closed verifier remain authoritative.
securityRules: Never expose raw credentials, signing keys, GitHub tokens, cloud credentials, or provider secrets to generated code.
Never expose arbitrary shell, unrestricted code execution, production deployment, destructive repository mutation, key registration, revocation, or authorization-state mutation through Code Mode.
All external tool inputs must be schema-validated and authorized at the host boundary.
Search and analytics results are supporting evidence, not scientific or security authority.
Telemetry must not alter ALLOW, DENY, or INDETERMINATE decisions.
Provenance records must preserve source identity and retrieval metadata without treating source availability as validity.
